name: Patrick Gonzales
background: Patrick Gonzales ran as the Libertarian nominee for House District 15 in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Rawlins mailing address. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the filings and coverage reviewed for this Profile.
